name: GSBP-CP
description: This cyber-physical dataset was collected on an operational grid-tied photovoltaic (PV) installation at the Green & Smart Building Park of Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P), Morocco, instrumented as a cybersecurity testbed. The testbed includes a production Huawei SUN2000L-5KTL inverter polled over Modbus/TCP through a transparent Modbus proxy, an independent Shelly 3EM power meter publishing over MQTT, and a managed-switch mirror port for packet capture, all synchronised on a single NTP clock. Unlike simulated or hardware-in-the-loop datasets, every record comes from real equipment in operation. The independent meter cross-checks the power the inverter reports, so falsified inverter readings can be contradicted by a second instrument.
